privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.markdown:
# Privacy Policy


## 1. About this policy
Infimind ("Infimind", "we", "us" or "our") respects your privacy and is committed to handling personal information responsibly. This Privacy Policy explains what information we may collect when you visit our website, submit an enquiry, request a consultation, use an Infimind portal, or participate in an Infimind learning programme; why we use that information; when it may be shared; how long it may be retained; and the choices available to you.

This policy applies to Infimind's website, enquiry forms, programme communications, student and parent portals, and related online services that link to this policy.

## 2. Information we may collect
Depending on how you interact with Infimind, we may collect:

- Full name, email address, telephone number, country, city and time zone
- Parent or guardian details
- Student age or year of study, school, curriculum and academic background
- Programme interests, educational goals and preferred consultation times
- Information submitted through enquiries, assessments, surveys or support messages
- Documents, rough work, assignments, test responses or other learning materials voluntarily provided for programme delivery
- Account and profile information for portal access
- Payment and billing information, where applicable; card details may be processed directly by a payment provider rather than stored by Infimind
- IP address, browser, device, operating-system and approximate-location information
- Pages visited, actions taken, login records, security logs, cookies and similar technical data
- Diagnostic and assessment results, scores, timing, topic-level performance and learning-plan progress
- Question attempts, error patterns, mentor observations, feedback, rough-work analysis, study consistency, confidence reflections and parent progress-review notes

We collect only information reasonably required for the relevant purpose.

## 3. How we obtain information
We may receive information directly from a parent, guardian, student or visitor; through website forms, consultations, email, telephone or messaging; through an Infimind portal; from an authorised school, adviser or representative; automatically through cookies and logs; or from service providers supporting payments, scheduling, communications, hosting, analytics or security.

## 4. How we use information
We may use personal information to:

- Respond to enquiries and consultation requests
- Assess programme suitability
- Create and administer accounts
- Deliver and personalise learning programmes
- Prepare diagnostics, learning plans, question sets and progress reviews
- Provide mentoring, counselling and student support
- Communicate with parents, guardians and students
- Monitor progress and programme participation
- Improve teaching methods, programme design, portals and website experience
- Schedule sessions and send service-related reminders
- Process payments and maintain financial records
- Protect users, systems and accounts from misuse or unauthorised access
- Meet legal, regulatory, safeguarding, accounting or dispute-resolution obligations
- Send educational or programme updates where permitted
- Create aggregated or de-identified analysis that does not reasonably identify an individual

We do not sell personal information.

## 5. Legal grounds for processing
Where applicable law requires a legal basis, we may process information because it is necessary to take requested steps before an agreement; perform an agreement; pursue legitimate interests in operating, securing and improving our services; comply with a legal obligation; protect vital interests or support safeguarding; or because valid consent has been provided.

Where processing relies on consent, consent may be withdrawn, subject to legal and operational limitations.

## 6. Children and student information
Infimind provides educational services that may involve children and young people. We take additional care when handling student information.

- Enquiries and enrolments for minors should be made or authorised by a parent or legal guardian.
- Where legally required, we obtain or verify parental or guardian consent before collecting or using a child's personal information.
- We aim to present privacy information in clear, age-appropriate language.
- We use student information only for legitimate educational, administrative, safety and support purposes.
- We do not knowingly sell children's personal information or use it for behavioural advertising.
- Parents or guardians may contact us to request access to, correction of or deletion of a child's information, subject to applicable law and necessary educational, safeguarding or record-keeping requirements.

A child should not independently submit sensitive information through the website without a parent or guardian's involvement.

## 7. Sensitive and wellbeing information
Please do not submit medical, psychological or other highly sensitive information through general website forms. Where wellbeing-related information is voluntarily shared for student support, Infimind will limit collection and access to what is reasonably necessary.

Infimind's wellbeing support is educational and supportive in nature and is not a substitute for emergency, medical, psychiatric or clinical care.

## 8. Cookies and similar technologies
We may use cookies and similar technologies to keep the website and portals functioning, maintain sessions and security, remember preferences, understand performance, identify technical problems and measure use of content and features.

Where required, non-essential cookies will be used only after consent. You can control cookies through browser settings and any cookie controls made available on the website. Disabling certain cookies may affect functionality.

## 9. Sharing information
We may share information only where reasonably necessary with authorised Infimind team members; tutors, mentors and counsellors; hosting, cloud-storage and software providers; communication, scheduling and payment providers; analytics, security and technical-support providers; professional advisers; regulators, law-enforcement or safeguarding authorities where required or permitted; or a genuine successor organisation in a business reorganisation subject to appropriate safeguards.

Service providers are expected to use information only for the services they provide and to protect it appropriately.

We do not publish student information, testimonials or success stories unless appropriate permission has been obtained.

## 10. International processing
Infimind serves families in multiple countries and may use service providers located in different jurisdictions. Information may therefore be processed outside the country where it was collected. Where required, we use appropriate contractual, organisational or legal safeguards for international transfers.

## 11. Data retention
We retain personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary for programme delivery, account administration, safety, dispute resolution, accounting and legal compliance. Retention periods may vary according to the type of information, whether a programme is active, safeguarding considerations and applicable record-keeping requirements.

When information is no longer needed, we may delete, anonymise or securely archive it as appropriate.

## 12. Data security
We use reasonable technical and organisational measures designed to protect personal information against accidental loss, misuse, alteration, unauthorised access or disclosure. Measures may include access controls, authentication, secure hosting, backups, staff confidentiality obligations and monitoring.

No internet-based system can be guaranteed completely secure. Users should protect passwords and avoid sharing account credentials.

## 13. Your privacy rights
Depending on your location and applicable law, you may have rights to:

- Ask whether we hold personal information about you
- Request access to that information
- Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete information
- Request deletion
- Restrict or object to certain processing
- Withdraw consent
- Request a portable copy where applicable
- Object to direct marketing
- Complain to a relevant data-protection authority
- Authorise another person to exercise rights where permitted

These rights may be subject to legal exceptions. We may need to verify identity and authority before responding.

## 14. Marketing communications
We may send programme news, educational resources or service updates where permitted. You may unsubscribe from promotional email using the unsubscribe link or by contacting us. We may still send essential administrative or service communications relating to an active enquiry, account or programme.

## 15. Third-party links
Our website may contain links to external websites or services. Their privacy practices are governed by their own policies. Infimind is not responsible for external content or privacy practices.

## 16. Automated analysis
Infimind may use software to help organise learning information, identify performance patterns or support recommendations. Educational decisions are reviewed by appropriate team members and should not be based solely on automated processing where this would produce a legal or similarly significant effect.

## 17. Changes to this policy
We may update this Privacy Policy to reflect changes in services, technology or legal obligations. The revised version will display a new "Last updated" date. Material changes may also be communicated through the website, portal or email where appropriate.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.markdown:
# Terms of Service


## 1. About these terms
These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern access to and use of the Infimind website, portals, digital content and related services that link to these Terms.

"Infimind", "we", "us" and "our" refer to the Infimind business entity identified in the relevant enrolment, invoice or service agreement. "You" means the website visitor, account holder, parent, guardian, student or authorised user, as applicable.

By using the website or an Infimind portal, you agree to these Terms. Programme-specific services may also be governed by a separate proposal, enrolment form, payment terms, service agreement or written confirmation. If a programme-specific agreement conflicts with these website Terms, the programme-specific agreement controls for that service.

## 2. Eligibility and minors
A person entering into a paid programme agreement must have legal capacity to do so. Where a student is a minor, a parent or legal guardian must authorise enrolment and account use, provide accurate information and supervise use where appropriate.

## 3. Website information and enquiries
Website content describes Infimind's approach and available services in general terms.

- Submitting an enquiry does not guarantee admission, availability or a particular programme structure.
- Programme suitability may depend on consultation, diagnostic assessment, goals, timeline, staffing and other relevant factors.
- Fees, duration, scheduling, deliverables and support arrangements are confirmed separately.
- Website content is not a binding offer unless expressly stated.

## 4. Educational services
Infimind may provide diagnostic assessments, personalised learning plans, teaching sessions, mentoring, academic counselling, wellbeing-oriented educational support, practice materials, mock assessments, progress analysis, parent reviews, portal access and educational resources.

The exact services included in a programme are those confirmed in writing for that enrolment. Infimind may reasonably adapt teaching sequence, materials, practice, personnel, schedules or delivery methods to meet educational needs, maintain quality or respond to availability.

## 5. No score or admission guarantee
Infimind provides educational guidance, preparation and support. We do not guarantee a particular SAT or examination score, admission to any institution, a scholarship, a ranking, a grade, a specific improvement within a fixed period or acceptance by a third party.

Outcomes depend on factors outside Infimind's control, including prior knowledge, attendance, effort, health, school demands, test conditions, deadlines, the accuracy of information provided and decisions made by educational institutions.

Testimonials and student stories describe individual experiences and are not guarantees of future outcomes.

## 6. User responsibilities
Users agree to provide accurate information, attend and participate in agreed sessions, complete assigned work honestly, communicate scheduling issues promptly, use feedback and materials for legitimate educational purposes, treat staff and other users respectfully, protect login details and use the website and portal lawfully.

## 7. Academic integrity
Students must not use Infimind's services or materials to cheat, impersonate another person, falsify work, obtain unauthorised examination content or violate school, testing-body or university rules. Infimind may refuse assistance that would facilitate academic misconduct and may suspend access for serious or repeated violations.

## 8. Accounts and security
Users must keep login details confidential, use only the account assigned to them, avoid sharing access and notify Infimind of suspected unauthorised use. Infimind may suspend or reset access where reasonably necessary to protect users, systems or information.

## 9. Scheduling, cancellations and missed sessions
Scheduling, rescheduling, cancellation, missed-session and refund rules are confirmed in the programme-specific agreement or enrolment communication.

Unless confirmed otherwise in writing, sessions are subject to educator availability, users should provide reasonable notice when requesting changes, and Infimind may reschedule where an educator is unavailable or technical, safety or operational issues arise.

No universal cancellation or refund promise applies unless formally confirmed in writing.

## 10. Fees and payments
Fees, taxes, instalments, payment dates and accepted methods are stated in the relevant invoice, proposal or enrolment agreement. Users are responsible for paying amounts when due and providing accurate billing information. Third-party payment providers may apply their own terms and privacy policies.

## 11. Learning materials and intellectual property
Unless otherwise stated, Infimind owns or is licensed to use the website and programme materials, including branding, text, designs, graphics, videos, recordings, presentations, assessments, question sets, learning plans, frameworks, templates, portal layout, software, reports and educational resources.

Infimind grants the authorised user a limited, personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable and revocable right to use programme materials for their own learning during the relevant programme.

Without prior written permission, users must not copy, publish, sell, sublicense, distribute, upload to public repositories or AI-training datasets, share paid resources, record sessions without authorisation, remove ownership notices, reverse engineer software or use Infimind branding misleadingly.

## 12. Session recordings
Sessions will not be recorded unless recording is part of the confirmed service or appropriate notice and consent have been provided. Recordings must not be copied or shared without permission and may be retained only for the relevant purpose.

## 13. Student wellbeing and safeguarding
Infimind may provide wellbeing-oriented guidance relating to study habits, motivation, exam pressure and learning routines. This support is educational and supportive and is not medical, psychiatric, psychological or emergency treatment.

Parents and guardians remain responsible for obtaining appropriate professional or emergency help when needed. Infimind may contact a parent, guardian or appropriate authority where there is a reasonable safeguarding concern or where disclosure is required or permitted by law.

## 14. Acceptable use
Users must not use the website or portal unlawfully; harass or threaten others; upload harmful code; probe system vulnerabilities; bypass access controls; scrape substantial content; disrupt the service; misrepresent identity; collect another user's information without permission; or use materials to create a competing commercial product.

## 15. Third-party services and links
Infimind may use or link to third-party tools for meetings, payments, calendars, communications, analytics, hosting or educational resources. Third-party services are governed by their own terms and policies.

References to universities, testing organisations or third-party brands do not imply endorsement or affiliation unless expressly stated.

**SAT is a trademark of the College Board. Infimind and Navichi are not affiliated with or endorsed by the College Board unless explicitly stated otherwise.**

## 16. Availability and changes
We aim to provide reliable access but do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free availability. We may perform maintenance, correct errors, modify features, update materials or suspend features for security, legal or operational reasons.

## 17. Suspension and termination
Infimind may suspend or terminate access because of non-payment, serious or repeated breach, academic misconduct, harassment, unsafe conduct, unauthorised sharing, security risk or fraudulent information. Where appropriate, we may provide notice and an opportunity to address the issue.

## 18. Disclaimers
To the extent permitted by law, website content is provided for general information, educational materials may contain occasional errors, and Infimind does not provide legal, medical, financial or admission guarantees. Users should verify official examination rules, deadlines and university requirements with the relevant institution.

Nothing in these Terms excludes rights or warranties that cannot lawfully be excluded.

## 19. Limitation of liability
To the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, Infimind will not be liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential or punitive loss, or for loss of opportunity, anticipated admission, scholarship, profits, data or reputation arising from use of the website or services.

Where liability cannot be excluded, Infimind's aggregate liability relating to a paid programme will not exceed the amount paid to Infimind for the specific service giving rise to the claim during the preceding six months, unless applicable law requires a different result.

This clause must be reviewed by a qualified lawyer before production use.

## 20. Privacy
Personal information is handled according to the Infimind Privacy Policy.

## 21. Changes to these Terms
We may update these Terms to reflect changes in services, law or operations. The current version will display the latest update date.

## 22. Governing law and disputes
Users are encouraged to contact Infimind first so concerns can be addressed in good faith.

## 23. Severability and waiver
If any provision is found invalid or unenforceable, the remaining provisions will continue to apply to the extent permitted by law. A failure to enforce a provision on one occasion does not waive the right to enforce it later.

## 24. Entire agreement
These Terms, together with the Privacy Policy and any applicable programme-specific agreement, form the agreement governing the relevant website or service use.
